the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the rank decomposition for the finite locally free morphism s has U_0 empty since s is surjective; membership u in U_r is detected by the degree of the scheme-theoretic fibre s^{-1}(u); the diagram lemma identifies pr_1^{-1}(z) as the common base change of the fibres over s(z) and t(z), so equivalent points lie in the same U_r and the pieces are R-invariant; the restriction R_r = s^{-1}(U_r) then has s of rank r, and t is isomorphic to s via the inverse, hence also of rank r (source lines 4519-4540)
